checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Realistic wooden cabin among pine trees in dawn lighting
must.why: Photoreal log cabin, ponderosa pines, pink dawn sky, light mist.

must.item: Camera advances smoothly toward front door
must.why: Cabin grows steadily larger and door stays centred across frames.

must.item: Foreground trees shift relative to cabin showing forward movement
must.why: Foreground trunks slide outward and past the frame edges; parallax is clear.
Cabin, door and windows stay consistent; no visible cuts or morphing in the sampled frames.
Frames are 16:9; the assistant says there is no audio. Silence cannot be verified from the frames.

faults.what: The cabin looks a bit pristine and its proportions change slightly, with the roof overhang shifting. These are minor artefacts.
Mist is faint, and the light is more dusk-pink than clear sunrise.

summary: A realistic log cabin among pines at dawn, with a smooth push toward the door and clear foreground parallax; only minor polish issues.
